title: Required Security Deposit on a Pending New Agreement
content:
**Clause.** The Security Deposit required on a new agreement still pending start is the deposit multiple of its kind times the kind's default average monthly bill, rounded to the cent and then up to the next whole dollar, raised to the kind's minimum deposit and limited to its maximum deposit. The default average monthly bill so used is the average monthly bill recorded on the deposit.


## Worked examples (hypothetical kinds)

| Hypothetical kind's figures | Product | Rounded to the cent, then up to whole dollars | Within minimum and maximum? | Deposit required (USD) | Average monthly bill recorded (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Multiple 2.0, default bill USD 310.00, minimum USD 250.00, maximum USD 5000.00 | 620.00 | 620 | Yes | 620.00 | 310.00 |
| Multiple 2.5, default bill USD 2400.00, minimum USD 1000.00, maximum USD 50000.00 | 6000.00 | 6000 | Yes | 6000.00 | 2400.00 |
| Multiple 2.0, default bill USD 45.30, minimum USD 100.00, maximum USD 600.00 | 90.60 | 91 | Below the minimum | 100.00 | 45.30 |

**Is the deposit required ever a figure with cents?** No. After rounding to the cent the amount is taken up to the next whole dollar, and the minimum and maximum are whole-dollar figures.
